_note: Hand-set coordinates that the gazetteer gets wrong, each with the reason. Applied over the machine lookups by geocode.load(). A correction here is a human claim and says so; nothing in this file was guessed, and every entry names what the automatic answer was and why it is not the place the archives mean.

senj.why: Nominatim ranks a HAMLET called Senj at Dugopolje, near Split, above the coastal town — the hamlet is a place/hamlet and the town is a boundary/administrative, so any ranking that prefers populated places picks the wrong one. Every Senj in this estate is the town under the Velebit.

senj croatia.why: As above — the same Dugopolje hamlet outranks the town.

transvaal.why: A province that no longer exists, so there is nothing to match: the bare name resolved to a street in Germany. Gauteng is the part of the old Transvaal this family was actually in, and the coordinate is approximate by nature.

cape colony.why: Also a polity rather than a place; it resolved to the United States. The Eastern Cape is where these records were made, and this is a regional centroid, not a town.
